summary: Learn to test ESG data, scope assurance, and deliver audit-ready sustainability reporting with practical tools and templates.
lede: Sustainability assurance training covers how ISAE 3000 (Revised) principles guide the examination of disclosures, data and controls. For professionals in sustainability reporting, audit, governance or risk oversight, it provides a practical approach to scoping engagements, mapping materiality and reporting boundaries, testing sustainability KPIs and controls, and documenting evidence, exceptions and findings.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with sustainability reporting, audit, governance, or risk oversight and need to validate data quality, testing logic, and assurance readiness in real reporting environments.
modules: Assurance of Social and Governance Data
prerequisites: You should come with working knowledge of sustainability reporting concepts, basic audit or control principles, and comfort reading KPI tables, source documents, and management reports. Prior experience with ESG reporting, internal audit, assurance, risk, compliance, or finance controls will help you move faster, but no coding is required. If your team already uses spreadsheets, document repositories, or audit workflows, bring a laptop and, where possible, a sample sustainability KPI dataset or reporting pack for practical exercises.
